verdict.rationale: Anomaly or outlier detection is a fair question for an observability and alerting platform like SigNoz, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents conventional alerts on log patterns, counts, or attribute values and an AI use case for tuning noisy alerts. Nothing shows anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds
